events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in 1960s counterculture, took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. What's your top track from the legendary Woodstock line-up?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King. Elvis Presley would have been 91 today, his music and iconic style still influencing generations. Which Elvis track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer, guitarist, and primary songwriter of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Celebrating 75 years of pure rock 'n' roll attitude! Chrissie Hynde, the legendary voice of The Pretenders, is celebrating her birthday today. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice and co-founder of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Wish
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over 60 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... on what would have been John Lennon's 86th birthday. His message of peace and love continues to resonate. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant British comedian and actor, John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Humour
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead vocalist of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on. On this day, we remember the legendary Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. What's the Queen song that truly showcases his iconic voice for you?
